as_told.title: Ted Owens' powers from the mantids Twitter and Tweeter

plain: Jeffrey Mishlove, a researcher with a doctorate who studies psychic claims, told podcast host Jesse Michels what Ted Owens, a man who said he had psychic powers, claimed was the source of his abilities. Owens said he sent telepathic messages to his friends, the "space intelligences", beings shaped like praying mantises living in an invisible giant UFO hovering over the Earth, and that they carried out what he asked. If true, it would mean unseen beings above us answer to a single human's thoughts.
